plan.primary_metric: pooled RMSD of 15 constrained chemical tip atoms across HIS/ASP/GLN/CYS BEFORE guidepost coordinate insertion, in the shared model frame; no tip fitting

plan.threshold_scope: descriptive cutoff from existing insertion metric documentation, not a population equivalence gate
plan.selection_for_images: seed11 sample0 for every arm, plus worst tip-RMSD sample across all arms; no best-only selection
